div.class: border rounded bg-light p-3 mb-3 o_cs_screen_guide
div.p: What is this screen? A short preparation note for an upcoming customer call or meeting.

ul.li: Understand the current customer situation before the conversation.
Review suggested talking points, risks, and the main meeting objective.
Regenerate the briefing when customer data or the meeting purpose changes.

div.p: Start here: Read the briefing, verify important facts and dates, and prepare your questions. Do not read it as a script; listen to the customer and update the record after the call.

button.name: action_regenerate
button.help: Regenerate the briefing after changing the contact purpose or when fresher customer data is available. Verify risks, talking points, and dates against source records before the call.
Close the briefing. It is preparation guidance only and does not contact the customer or schedule an activity.
